## Checklist

- [ ] `cookbook validate` passes
- [ ] `cookbook index` has been run, and the regenerated files are committed
- [ ] Every changed recipe has a version bump and a `CHANGELOG.md` entry ([versioning](https://github.com/dr-stutters/cml-cookbook/blob/main/docs/versioning.md))
- [ ] Follows the [conventions](https://github.com/dr-stutters/cml-cookbook/blob/main/docs/conventions.md)
- [ ] No real addresses, hostnames, secrets, license keys or Cisco software
- [ ] Any new `tested_on` entry records a real CML run (pass or fail)
